title: Sync disabled
symptom: On both the phone (sync master) and tablet (sync follower), the 'Disable all sync features' setting became checked without user action, causing sync to stop. Rebooting after unchecking restored sync.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. The maintainer notes changes in the most recent nightly relating to disabling sync processing earlier in the application life-cycle if that setting is enabled, but cannot see how that could enable the setting by itself.
fix: The user resolved the issue by unchecking 'Disable all sync features' on both devices and rebooting, which resumed sync.
evidence_quote: Then I looked at my phone and was astonished to see that "Disable all sync features" was checked there too! Reboot and sync has resumed.
